description: Guest asks to cancel within 24 hours of booking, 16 days before check-in. History contains a prior host message. Should trigger full refund rule + detect prior commitment and escalate rather than restate policy.
guestMessage: Hi, we actually need to cancel right away. We just booked yesterday. What refund would we get?

conversationHistory.body: If you need to cancel, the normal policy would apply based on timing.

notes: High-risk anti-contradiction case. Prior host statement exists. Even though math says full refund (24h + 14+ days), the agent should escalate instead of giving a new definitive answer that could contradict the earlier vague host message.
